Hi Tessa,

Thanks for the quick demo last week — the product looks promising. Procurement is starting vendor setup and we need to ingest a compliance package before we can create a PO and issue the vendor code. Can you please provide the following artifacts so we can move forward?

Must-haves (for our procurement system):
- SOC 2 Type II report (most recent) or SOC 2 summary + auditor contact
- ISO 27001 certificate or scope statement
- External penetration test attestation letter (summary and date)
- Data flow diagram showing where customer data is stored/processed (high level)
- Completed vendor onboarding form (we can also accept your vendor packet)

Additional helpful items:
- Any PCI/HIPAA scoping notes if applicable
- SOC 2 CSV of controls mapping (if you have it)

Timeline: we need these uploaded to our portal by Sep 10 to make the current quarter PO window. If you expect any delays please let us know — we can potentially accept redacted reports where necessary.

Contact for PO routing: procurement@helixmed.com (cc'ed). Vendor code will be assigned once evidence is accepted.

Appreciate it — Daniel

Fast answers to a couple of your questions:
- HIPAA/PCI: Redwood supports HIPAA workloads via Private deployment and appropriate contractual addenda; our SOC 2 covers security controls but is NOT a HIPAA attestation. If you need explicit HIPAA scoping we can provide supporting docs and an estimated turnaround.
- Control mapping CSV: We can provide a controls mapping export, but it requires a short internal approval. If needed, I can push it and send by Aug 27.

Next steps I propose:
1) I will upload the above artifacts to the DocuSign/portal link you prefer (or send a single ZIP) by close of business Fri 2026-08-27.
2) Marissa and Ben (cc'ed) will validate the pen test attestation and SOC redaction.
3) Once accepted, you can assign the vendor code and route the PO to procurement@helixmed.com.

Please confirm whether you prefer a single ZIP or separate files in the portal.
